about: Spec 008 names table (T023), table part: the names that come from a game table, as recipes without the text, resolved in the tree worker over the installed game. Each group reads <table>[index...] (and .field) for each of its keys ([call or path, index]), applies the transform and puts the text in the template ({0}; null = the text alone); multi holds the recipes of several parts ([call or path, template, [[table, index, field, transform]...]]). A recipe resolves only when the sha256 of each table it reads equals its hash in hashes ([sha256, table]; canonical form: every {h: ...} wrapper unwrapped, object keys sorted, then JSON.stringify; CustomLists.X and CustomMaps.X whole, ItemDefinitionsGET.<id> and MonsterDefinitionsGET.<id> per entry). Converted from the bench's names-008 export (NAMES-008-table-recipes.json, NAMES-008-table-hashes.json).
